utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Sam, the repair drive is this Saturday at 10 AM! Want to help fix up the community garden tools?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I'm already helping Cleo with sorting parts, so I'll be there to fix those tools!

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great to hear, Sam! See you Saturday at 10 AM then!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard it's this Saturday from 10 to 4. I'm bringing my truck full of tools.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks for the info. I'll plan to be there to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Awesome, Rey! I'll have plenty of tools if you need to borrow any.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Sam, that's perfect timing! We're really short on lumber for the drive—if you could help source some, that'd be amazing.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Cleo, do we have a final schedule? I want to make sure I'm there on time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're starting at 9 AM Saturday at the community center. I'll send out a reminder later.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! Faye, you mentioned you'd snap a pic and text it to me?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I'll send it over this afternoon!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, I'll keep an eye on my phone then. Thanks, Faye!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Uli, are you referring to the repair drive at the community center this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, that's the one. I've been trying to find the right bolts for the swings, it's been a struggle.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which swings are you working on? I might have some spare bolts in my garage.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Dane, are you planning to come to the repair drive this Saturday? It should be a lot of fun fixing things together.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I'll be there, but I might be a bit late. Is that okay?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Dane! We'll have flexible time slots, so just come when you can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Uli, how's the repair drive going? Any updates?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Uli, what's the exact schedule for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I think it's this Saturday at 10 AM, right?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh Rey, it's a community repair drive to fix up the neighborhood. But I'm fretting about how we'll schedule everyone so it doesn't turn into chaos.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help map out a schedule if you need, Pia. I've got the locations and parts list handy.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That's a relief, Opal. I'll sleep better knowing someone's tackling the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: A repair drive? What exactly are you trying to fix?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I'm not entirely sure what's being fixed, but I heard it's happening this Saturday at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Saturday at 10, huh? We'll see if anyone actually shows up with broken stuff.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Bo, have you heard? The repair drive is actually happening this weekend — we're finally gonna fix those old swings!

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh yeah, I think I remember something about that. I'll try to swing by, but I'm pretty booked.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, if you do make it, I've got some old fence planks I'm bringing—every little bit helps!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, are you free this Saturday? There's a repair drive at the community center at 9 AM!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Bring your broken items Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I'll see you there! And if you know anyone else who might want to come, spread the word!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, I almost forgot—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead of Saturday. Hope that still works for you!

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, thanks for letting me know Rosa! Sunday works for me—I'll be there with my toaster.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, I'll add you to the list! See you Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Nell, have you had a chance to check out the sign-up sheet for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not yet, where would I find the sign-up sheet?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It's posted in the hallway by the main office. I can snap a picture and text it to you if you like.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great to hear you're in, Mara! Actually, I just got word—the drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center instead. Still on for helping?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, that's changing things up... I hope everyone gets the new date. Are we sure the community center can handle all of us plus the tools?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, I've already checked with them—plenty of room. I'll put up signs at the old spot to redirect folks.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: You sure this repair drive is actually happening? I've heard about these things before and nothing came of it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, Vik confirmed it's this Saturday at 10 AM. I'm planning to be there.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Vik said so? Hmph. I'll believe it when I see it with my own eyes.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I appreciate you asking, Vik. I'll be there as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great! It's at 10 AM on Saturday, hope to see you there!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I'll do my best to be there by 10.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? I'm helping Cleo sort parts for it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I heard about it! I think it's Saturday at 9 AM, right? I'll be there a bit late though.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, see you there! Let me know if you need help with anything before then.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Leo, I'm organizing a repair drive and we're really short on lumber. Do you happen to have any spare boards?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I have some scraps in the garage. How many do you need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, thanks Leo! We could use at least a dozen boards if you have that many.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good morning, Mina! Have you seen Rosa with the list of houses for the repair drive? I want to start mapping out the route.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Is Rosa the one organizing the repair drive then?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: No, actually Cleo is organizing it. I'm just helping with the logistics—keeping a map of where help is needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, a repair drive? I think I remember hearing about that... wait, what is it again?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: It's a neighborhood thing where we help each other with minor repairs. I think Gus is organizing it with his tools.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Gus, you say? The guy with the big toolbox? I think I saw him fixing his fence last week... or was that someone else?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Jules, I've got my truck loaded with tools for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, Gus! Thanks for bringing those. I'll set up a spot for them at the garden.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Jules. I'll bring them over to the garden.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, it's on Saturday at 10 at the community garden. I think I have a flyer somewhere…

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I'll be there with my broken toaster. Thanks for the reminder!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Awesome, bring that toaster! I'll probably forget my wrench, but we'll figure it out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks Rey, I'd appreciate that. Still trying to nail down the exact start time and what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's at 9 AM on Saturday at the community center. We'll be fixing all sorts of things—toasters, bikes, you name it!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 9 AM at the community center, got it. That sounds good—I'll be there on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: It's the community repair drive—the one they announced last week at the center. I think it's scheduled for Saturday at 9 AM.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Wait, 9 AM? I thought it was 10 to 4. Might've skimmed the flyer.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, you're right—I think I might've mixed that up. Let me double-check the flyer to confirm the times.
